_comment: The read-through map. This is the part no API gives you and the only part
that is real edge: which small company re-rates on someone ELSE's readout.
Built by reading the small company's own transcripts and slides, where they
name their competitors and their catalysts.
direction: 'up'   = this readout succeeding is good for this ticker
'down' = this readout succeeding is bad for this ticker
'own'  = it is this company's own trial (both directions live)
Trials are keyed by NCT ID, never by drug name. BRUNELLO is filed under
'EyeBiotech Ltd.' with the intervention named 'EYE103' - not Merck, not
MK-3000, not remigromig. Name matching would have missed it entirely.

names.note: Surrozen. SZN-8141 = Wnt agonist + VEGF antagonist for DME. The pure-play on Wnt working in the retina: 4.6M float, ~31% of it short as of 2026-09-24.

levered_to.why: Merck/EyeBio Wnt agonist vs ranibizumab in DME. First pivotal test of the mechanism Surrozen's whole pipeline depends on. Read out 2026-09-24: met primary endpoint, SRZN +108%. Year-2 data still to come.

names.note: Merck. Sponsor of BRUNELLO via EyeBiotech. Owns the catalyst but is far too large for it to move the stock - it is here so the trial is tracked, not because MRK is tradeable on it.
Regeneron. Eylea / Eylea HD incumbent. A new mechanism reaching non-inferiority against anti-VEGF is a franchise threat, not a win.

levered_to.why: Wnt success erodes the anti-VEGF standard of care.

names.note: Ocular Therapeutix. OTX-TKI (axitinib implant), Phase 3, n=825, primary completion estimated 2027-01-08. Surfaced by the discovery pass, not hand-added - its own binary event, small cap.
